title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(竹内申一研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Takeuchi Shinichi)
keywords: Architectural design 2.Urban and landscape design 3.Integration with structure and environment 4.History reference 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Seeing and analyzing architecture or reading books by architects and researchers, to learn and evaluate what is architecture. Learn ability to analyze and consider the state of society surrounding architecture, set issues from a clear perspective, and acquire the ability to create architectural projects that can solve them. Learn ability to logically explain the concept of the work and the ability to express the work in excellent graphics.
advice: Previous semester ・Select sites and programs for a given theme and work on design issues that will be compiled into architectural works. ・Conduct basic research for graduation design. Second semester ・Finalize the graduation design theme, program and site. ・Produces a graduation design that summarizes the results of one year, and receives a review and commentary at a public presentation examination committee for PDⅢ. Other ・Work on laboratory project activities. Learning advice ・Always have interest of new knowledge and information about architecture and design. ・Experience a good architectural space and find out own architectural view . ・Learn the design process and ideas from architects' works and books. ・Apply for architectural design competitions for students.
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable to have completed Architectural Design Studio I, II, and Architectural Integrated Exercises for Design A, B and to have further studied subjects such as Method of Architectural Design, Theory of Architectural Space, and Architectural Information Design. It is also important to learn as much as possible in other specialized fields, such as history, cities, structures, and the environment, and make efforts to have broad knowledge.

activityGoals.body: Take memorandums and sketches about beautiful buildings, cities, landscapes, etc.
Understand the meaning and effectiveness of historical and modern masterpieces, and compare them with own works.
Consider about designs based on architectural materials, structures, technologies, and apply them to own works.
Select the site of the work and assemble the facility program which is a prerequisite for the design.
Analyzes various problems in modern society and presents improvement plans through works.
Present the completed image of own work with graphics, models, etc., and explain it logically.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・Understand the design theories and concepts underlying each famous architectural design and evaluate from various perspectives including social and historical backgrounds. Apply and develop such analytical skills in own work. ・Analyzing the architectural issues facing modern society, launching improvement projects, and proposing superior architectural spaces suitable for the project. ・Express one's work attractively with drawings, models, etc., and logically explain the design concept.
achievementLevels.standard: ・Analyze design theories and concepts that underlie excellent architectural design and evaluate them, including their historical and social backgrounds. ・Analyzing the architectural issues facing modern society, launching improvement projects, and proposing an architectural space suitable for the project. ・Express own work with drawings and models, and explain the design concept logically.
